text:
For a pool or beach, I'd start with the **JBL Charge 6** for the best all-around balance, or the **Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM** if you want a 360-degree sound that floats. The Soundcore Boom 2 Plus is a strong value if you can handle its weight.

## Top picks

**1. JBL Charge 6: best overall**
- IP68 rating, the highest-rated water protection among the picks I compared, and it stays strong for beach and pool use. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) lists 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) cites up to 28 hours.
- Doubles as a power bank for your phone.
- Price: $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon, per What Hi-Fi. Best Products listed a $150 deal.
- Battery claims vary between sources, so check the spec for the exact model you buy.

**2. Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM: best mid-range**
- [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) names it its best mid-range pick. It's IP67 and floats, and its 360-degree design sounds consistent wherever you sit or swim.
- Battery is about 15 hours, shorter than the Charge 6's.
- [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) names it its overall best.

**3. JBL Boombox 4: best for big parties**
- [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) calls it the best waterproof speaker it has tested. It's protected against long immersion, floats, and has a battery lasting over 40 hours.
- Downsides: it's larger, and its directivity is narrow, so it can sound muffled off to the side or behind.

**4. Soundcore Boom 2 Plus: best value for loud sound**
- Dealectric lists it at $249.99, with a 100W output that floats, IPX7 water protection, and up to 20 hours at half volume. The code AFSC20 took $49.99 off in a cart test on October 22, 2026, and it expires December 31, 2026.
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). Dealectric earns a commission on this link at no extra cost to you. The checkout price is final, so confirm the discount there.
- Caveats: it weighs 3.8 kg, and the official Bluetooth version is listed inconsistently (6.0 on the product page, 5.3 in the manual).

**Budget and portable options**
- **Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4:** IP67, floats, and about 13–14 hours of battery. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) lists it at $65 (was $80).
- **Tribit PocketGo:** IP68 and strong sound for its size, per [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers).
- **JBL Grip:** a can-sized, under-one-pound IP68 speaker for beach trips, $100 per [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/). Its mesh surface can look dusty after outdoor use.

## Before you buy

- **IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine.** RTINGS notes that frequent exposure to salt, soap, or chlorine can break down the surface, especially on fabric. Rinse with fresh water after use.
- **Protect it at the beach.** Keep it on a towel or raised surface rather than in sand, close every port cover, and dry it before charging, as [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/) advises.
- **Keep it away from the pool edge** so a splash or bump can't knock it in.
- **I could not verify live prices or buy links** for most of these models. Confirm current prices on the retailer's site.
